says: In today's CI, the host.yaml rules H4, H6 and H9 say each hand-started suite runs only its fixed test files, but they check only the named law step, so an added step that runs another test file passes all three.
proof: A scratch script parsed host.yaml at 81a8185, inserted `{ run: "pnpm exec vitest run --project tooling .github/ci/proof.test.ts" }` before the proof step of each of the e88-r6, box and p8 jobs in turn, and called lintHost on each; it printed `e88-r6 []`, `box []` and `p8 []` (no errors). host.ts:89, :116 and :145 read the step lists, and each rule only checks the env and continue-on-error of steps other than the law step.
cost: A suite can quietly run extra laws beside its proof, so its rule text ('runs only the fixed ... file') is not what the lint holds, and a proof run's duration and result can include work the lint claims to forbid.
